line: A yellow umbrella left on a bus waits out a sunny day on the lost-property shelf, then opens with 312 others when the storm comes back: objects, vehicles, weather and signs as beat-locked geometric pictograms.
line_cn: 一把被落在公交车上的黄伞，晴天里在失物招领的货架上等了一整天，暴雨回来时和另外 312 把一起撑开：物件、交通、天气和标识，都是卡着节拍的几何象形符号。
uses: Explainers told through signs and objects

camera.expresses: clarity, the card as a poster
camera.serves: any item; a spec that must be read

camera.move: Lateral track with a one-screen whip per beat
camera.serves: a line of stations; a production line; a route
a gallery; a menu; a slower chapter
a top-ten; floors of a building; ocean depths

camera.move: Push into one motif cell until it becomes the next frame
camera.serves: an ingredient inside a dish; a city inside a map

camera.move: Pull back to a tiled wall of items
camera.serves: a summary; "all of them"; a comparison
a merger; a shared goal; a count reaching zero

camera.move: Split screen along a grid line

transitions: energy comes from row shifts, transitions and figure actions.
Allowed transitions are the grid ones in §5;
never dissolves, 3D camera moves, handheld shake or depth of field.
labels: Title: a 900-weight grotesk (e.g. Inter Tight), 150–330 px at 1080p, tight tracking, auto-fitted. Second language: a heavy face under it. Meta: a mono (e.g. DM Mono) ~22 px, wide tracking; tags as mono chips.
HUD on every card: mono corner text and a progress bar of N ticks (current tall, done dimmed, rest faint), N derived from the item list.
Bilingual rule: one language is always the big title; the second language is chosen per version by a switch, never by hand-editing cards.

The card type is the text layer. With narration, captions are two lines on a solid band in the chapter's darkest tone (an ink band on light hues), bottom left, never over the title: the second language in a heavy face over the English in mono; hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s). A card that must be read (a spec, a number) holds ≥ 1.6 s.
motion: A grid of time: pick one tempo for the film; every shot starts on a beat and every key action in a pose (release, contact, landing) lands on an integer beat.
Pace ladder: normal cards last one bar; related sub-items become half-length rapid-fire runs. A second tempo comes from dividing the beat, never from changing tempo.
Easing: exponential ease-out for entrances, exponential in-out for whips and wipes; a back ease once at most.
Type enters by mask slide-up: title first, second line ~0.08 s later, tag after; meta lines type on without a caret. Short cards compress all timings.

native_moves.name: One card = one item
native_moves.does: The count is the hook ("ALL N").
native_moves.fits: every tool in a workshop; every station of a subway line; every dish of a regional cuisine.

native_moves.name: Chapter = colour
native_moves.does: Families become hues so the viewer always knows where they are.
native_moves.fits: instrument sections of an orchestra; food groups; departments of a company.

native_moves.name: One verb per item
native_moves.does: One body action readable in a bar, or a prop action (a gear turns, a cup pours).
native_moves.fits: yoga poses; kitchen techniques; jobs on a construction site.

native_moves.name: Pace ladder run
native_moves.fits: four knife cuts; the bones of a hand; weekday routines.

native_moves.name: Long take down a track
native_moves.does: Stations one screen apart, the camera whipping on each cut.
native_moves.fits: the steps of a recipe; checkpoints of a marathon; stages of a rocket launch.

native_moves.name: Count-up slam
native_moves.does: A big number rolls to its value on a bar.
native_moves.fits: tonnes recycled; members of a club; years of a company.

native_moves.name: Icon wall
native_moves.does: All pictograms return as a grid and turn one colour.
native_moves.fits: a summary of a year; a periodic table of habits; a team roster.

score.note: percussion is the spine; mallets and saw stabs on top
